title: The Social Responsibility Stack: A Control-Theoretic Architecture for Governing Socio-Technical AI

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes a theoretical framework for monitoring group-conditioned error rates (e.g., bounding false-negative and false-positive rate disparities) and tracking fairness drift across demographic subpopulations over time using divergence measures.
Illustrates the framework using a theoretical case study of a credit-scoring model, proposing design-time safeguards to bound false-negative-rate disparities across different socioeconomic groups.
